'''Trollweiss Mountain''' is a snowy mountain located in [[Troll Country]] and is one of the largest mountains in [[Gielinor]]. The [[Troll Romance]] quest must be completed, and players must have a [[sled]] to travel over it.

It is covered year-round in a thick layer of ice and snow, and powerful winds constantly sweep across it. Because of this harsh environment, little can survive apart from [[Ice wolf|ice wolves]], [[evergreen tree]]s, and the endangered [[Trollweiss]] flower.

To reach the mountain peak, players must enter a cave north of the [[Troll Stronghold (location)|Troll Stronghold]] and just west of the [[Ice Path]]. The cave is filled with [[ice troll]]s and leads to the summit. On the summit, the [[Gnome|gnomish]] explorer [[Brambickle]] can be found, along with a tunnel that leads to a [[Zemouregal's Fort|fort]] owned by the [[Mahjarrat]] [[Zemouregal]].

The mountain slopes down steeply from north to south, making northward travel impossible on land. Players must use a [[sled]] to slide down from the summit. Along the slope are an [[uncut sapphire]], multiple [[chaos rune]] spawns, and another [[sled]] in case players lose theirs. At the base of the mountain is a tunnel that leads to both [[Keldagrim]] and the [[Fremennik Province]]. Sliding down the slope rewards the player with 25 [[Agility]] experience. There are two animations for sliding down the slope, one where player will go over a jump, and one where player will crash into rocks. Crashing into rocks causes no damage to the player.

{{Clear|left}}
[[File:Trollweiss summit.png|thumb|Ice wolves prowling around the summit of the mountain.|none]]

==Transportation==
The entrance to Trollweiss Mountain is not marked on the world map. Don't forget to bring your waxed [[sled]] if intending to traverse down the mountain!{{Map|x=2820|y=3748|mtype=pin|group=pinex|caption=Cave entrance location, leading to the summit|align=right|zoom=1}} 

To reach the top of Trollweiss Mountain:
* Teleport to [[Trollheim]] using [[Ghommal's hilt]]/[[Trollheim Teleport]]/[[Stony basalt]].
* Go up the path north-west of Trollheim (use [[Protect from Missiles]] if the [[Thrower troll]]s target you).
* Enter the dungeon entrance to the west at the top of the path.
* Leave through the exit to the north-west. Beware of [[Ice troll]]s ([[Protect from Melee]] is effective here).

==Treasure Trails==

Although requiring only partial completion of [[Troll Romance]], players need to slide down to where [[Trollweiss]] grows on Trollweiss Mountain in order to complete an elite [[cryptic clue]]: [[Clue scroll (elite) - Green is the colour of my death|''Green is the colour of my death as the winter-guise, I swoop towards the ground.'']]

The same location is also used for the [[Treasure Trails/Guide/Emote clues/Elite|elite emote clue]]: [[Clue scroll (elite) - Panic at the area flowers meet snow|''Panic at the area flowers meet snow. Equip blue d'hide vambraces, a dragon spear and a rune plateskirt.'']]

Speaking to [[Brambickle]] is required for a hard anagram clue: [[Clue scroll (hard) - BAKER_CLIMB|''This anagram reveals who to speak to next: BAKER CLIMB.'']]

==Trivia==
*"[[wiktionary:weiss|Weiss]]" (or "[[wiktionary:weiß|weiß]]") is German for white. The name is a play on the mountain flower found in the Alps above the treeline "{{Wp|Edelweiss}}".
